1.explanation: The issue is related to the 'Show Code' button displaying <FeatureFlags> tags instead of the actual component code. To reproduce this, you can create a simple React component that uses the <FeatureFlags> component with a flag set, similar to what is shown in the bug report. This will simulate the incorrect code being displayed when the 'Show Code' button is clicked.
1.bug_scenario: The bug occurs when clicking the 'Show Code' button in the 'Docs' section of the Notifications component. Instead of displaying the expected code for the Notifications component, it shows irrelevant code wrapped in <FeatureFlags> tags. The displayed code is: <FeatureFlags flags={{ 'enable-v11-release': true }}> <No Display Name /> </FeatureFlags>. This issue might affect other components' 'Docs' sections as well.
